snippet.title: QUIET | Playtest Open NOW on STEAM
snippet.description:
The wait is over! Our Playtest is OFFICIALLY LIVE! 🎮

Jump in, explore, and let us know what you think! Drop your feedback and suggestions on our Steam Community Page or right here in the comments. 

:duck:Steam:   / https://store.steampowered.com/app/4228630/QUIET/
:duck:Youtube:   / https://www.youtube.com/@Play_QUIET
:duck:Discord:  / https://discord.com/invite/8NF6AA8kW
:duck:Instagram  / https://www.instagram.com/quiet_official_line/
:duck:Tik Tok: https://www.tiktok.com/@quiet_official?is_from_webapp=1&sender_device=pc


We can’t wait to hear your thoughts! Happy gaming! 
#QuietOfficial #IndieGame #IndieDev
